title: Robin at the Frosted Gate Christmas Greeting Card Printable, Two Designs
description:
A warm Christmas greetings card set featuring Robin at the Frosted Gate, ready to download and print.

Choose from two included designs:
• Merry Christmas
• Christmas Wishes

Both designs include the message: “Wishing you a joyful Christmas and a happy New Year”.

You will receive:
• PDF files in A4 and US Letter formats
• 4×6 in card panels
• 3 original artwork PNG files
• A printing guide

Print your chosen card file, then trim and fold it using the included printing guide. The A4 and US Letter versions fold into greetings cards, while the 4×6 in card panels offer another print format.

This is an instant digital download supplied as a ZIP file containing PDF and PNG files. No physical item is shipped.
